raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* #44973
* #44972
* #44971
* #44970
* #44969
* #43326
* #43325
* #43171
* #43170
* __->__ #43168

Current head `dd96b50e68`, based on main `e17fed6ea7`. Stack predecessor: main `e17fed6ea7`. This PR targets `main` after its stack predecessor merged.

## Motivation

When an SWA window is not page-aligned, decode eviction can leave less than a full window below the page where a prefix-cache insertion ends. For a 127-token window at page size 64, the residue `pre_len = 63 mod 64` retains only 64 tokens there, so the inserted prefix cannot be reused.

## Modifications

Round `max(window, page)` up to whole pages before deriving the eviction frontier. Page-aligned windows and page size 1 keep the same frontier; an unaligned window retains at most one more SWA page per request.

The regression uses a 7-token window at page size 4. After eviction at `pre_len=23`, it directly checks that the insertion boundary at 20 still has at least 7 live SWA tokens below it, then verifies release accounting. Restoring the old rounding makes the new frontier assertion fail (4 < 7).

## Accuracy Tests

Earlier combined stack `b550cacde6` adds a test-fixture correction in #43326: the Gemma4 read-stream fixture declares its FULL address space, and the HiSparse registry test uses real `CacheInitParams` for the retained-window calculation. Both complete test files pass locally with GPUs hidden: 4 Gemma4 tests and 26 registry tests. Pre-commit passed. The five descendant patches are unchanged (`git range-diff`); this follow-up changes no production code. The earlier 455-test run did not cover these two files; GitHub CI has not yet been revalidated for this head.

Validation before the test-fixture follow-up, on combined stack `4cf27a551c`: 455 tests and 921 subtests passed on B300, plus the two widened-history regressions against Rust TreeCore. The new FULL-fallback metadata cases cover eager execution and CUDA graph replay. New allocation-reclaim, explicit-prefill and JIT-reuse regressions fail on the previous code and pass with the fixes. These are combined-stack checks, not independent model reruns of each PR.

The measurements in this section are historical results from before this rebase, at the revisions/configurations stated below. Current combined-stack validation is linked above.

SM90, TP1, gpt-oss-20b with EAGLE3 on triton, page size 64, radix cache, overlap scheduler, `--mem-fraction-static 0.55`. GSM8K, all 1314 test questions, 5-shot, greedy. Every server ran with the per-step pool checks and the allocator invariants on (`SGLANG_ENABLE_STRICT_MEM_CHECK_DURING_BUSY=1 SGLANG_CHECK_KV_PAGE_INVARIANTS=1 SGLANG_INVARIANT_CHECK=1`), which stop a server at the step that leaks or frees a page twice. Baseline: the default pool, run twice. Unified: `--enable-unified-memory` with lazy compaction (the default) and eager compaction (`SGLANG_DISABLE_LAZY_COMPACTION=1`), on a poisoned pool (`SGLANG_DEBUG_POISON_POOL=1`). These ran on this commit over main 7224fce1b5.

| CUDA graphs | baseline / baseline repeat / unified eager / unified lazy | accept length |
|---|---|---|
| off | 0.533 / 0.561 / 0.552 / 0.530 | 1.27-1.28 |
| on | 0.552 / 0.558 / 0.557 / 0.521 | 1.27-1.28 |

Every server answered all 1314 questions with no leak, double free, invariant violation or illegal memory access. Without this change the same configuration leaked and double-freed KV on every arm, the default pool's included. gpt-oss-20b's GSM8K score moves by several points between identical runs: #42930's EAGLE3 table, which includes this change, has two identical default-pool runs 5.1 points apart (paired per question, z = 3.05). Here the lowest run, unified lazy with CUDA graphs, is at z = -1.9 and -2.2 against the two baseline runs, with the same accept length as every other arm.

GPU unit tests for unified memory, including this test file, which is registered for CUDA: 4102 passed, 0 failed.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The measurements in this section are historical results from before this rebase, at the revisions/configurations stated below. Current combined-stack validation is linked above.

Not measured: the change keeps at most one more SWA page per request, and only for a window that is not a whole number of pages.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).

- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -109,11 +109,12 @@ def free_swa_out_of_window_slots(
         # up to the window boundary (the trailing floor keeps it page-aligned).
         evict_threshold = pre_len - sliding_window_size
     else:
-        # Prefix-sharing cache: keep max(window, page). The trailing floor page-aligns the
-        # frontier, and subtracting at least one page keeps it below the insert
-        # boundary (page_floor(seq_len)) so the last leaf is never all-tombstone.
-        # No extra page margin is needed.
-        evict_threshold = pre_len - max(sliding_window_size, page_size)
+        # Prefix-sharing cache: keep max(window, page) rounded up to whole pages, so
+        # a key that ends at page_floor(pre_len) still has a full window of live SWA,
+        # and the last leaf, below page_floor(seq_len), is never all-tombstone.
+        evict_threshold = pre_len - ceil_align(
+            max(sliding_window_size, page_size), page_size
+        )
     if retain_floor is not None and supports_prefix_sharing:
         # The caller owns where the floor is (see BasePrefixCache.swa_retain_floor);
         # this only promises not to free past it. Without prefix sharing a retained

@@ -11501,6 +11501,59 @@ def test_match_after_insert_reaches_the_new_leaf(self):
         cache.unlock(req.lock)
         cache.sanity_check()
 
+    def test_finish_after_decode_eviction_frees_only_the_requests_pages(self):
+        # Decode evicts at pre_len = seq_len - 1. When the last verify then commits
+        # one token, the finished insert ends at page_floor(pre_len): the frontier
+        # must sit a full window below it although the window is not page-aligned.
+        cache, allocator, req_to_token_pool = build_fixture(self.cfg)
+        page_size = self.cfg.page_size
+        full_total = allocator.full_available_size()
+        swa_total = allocator.swa_available_size()
+        prompt_len, owned = 4 * page_size, 6 * page_size
+        tokens = list(range(1, owned + 1))
+
+        req = Req(
+            rid=0,
+            origin_input_text="",
+            origin_input_ids=array("q", tokens[:prompt_len]),
+            sampling_params=SamplingParams(
+                temperature=0, max_new_tokens=owned - prompt_len
+            ),
+        )
+        req_to_token_pool.alloc([req])
+        req.output_ids = []
+        req.full_untruncated_fill_ids = array("q", tokens[:prompt_len])
+        req.extend_end = prompt_len
+        kv_indices = self._alloc_paged(allocator, owned)
+        req_to_token_pool.write((req.kv.req_pool_idx, slice(0, owned)), kv_indices)
+        req.kv.kv_committed_len = prompt_len
+        req.kv.kv_allocated_len = owned
+        req.last_node = cache.root_node_handle()
+        req.kv.cache_protected_len = 0
+        req.lock = None
+        req.extra_key = None
+        cache.checkpoint(req, up_to=prompt_len)
+
+        req.output_ids = tokens[prompt_len:]
+        req.kv.kv_committed_len = owned
+        cache.evict_sliding_windows(req, owned - 1)
+        insert_boundary = (owned - 1) // page_size * page_size
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(
+            insert_boundary - req.kv.get_evicted_seqlen(ComponentType.SWA),
+            self.cfg.sliding_window_size,
+        )
+        req.finished_reason = FINISH_LENGTH(length=len(req.output_ids))
+        release_kv_cache(req, cache, checkpoint=True)
+
+        # Each page is back in the pool or held by the tree, never both.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            allocator.full_available_size() + cache.full_evictable_size(), full_total
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            allocator.swa_available_size() + cache.swa_evictable_size(), swa_total
+        )
+        cache.sanity_check()
+
